{"code": "df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates, keeping the last (highest sample_seq)
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify that we now have one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == df['patient_id'].nunique(), "Deduplication failed: number of unique patients does not match expected"

# Final count of enrolled patients
enrolled_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(enrolled_patients)"}
